answer: Each agent posts a refundable bond in escrow before it can claim any task. If a challenger proves two identities signed the same work trace, the bond is slashed and paid to the challenger. Forging identities only pays if the gain beats the stake, so cheating is a losing bet. Random raven-style audits choose which claims get checked. Every completed voyage is written to an append-only ledger, leaving a permanent umber trail that anyone can verify.
